method.design: 32 measured configurations: 8 established seeds × passive/balanced player policy × baseline/current rival AI. Complete dependency graph comes from pinned Stage14 engine5170cbc. Only src/ai.js differs between raw variants; src/player-ai.js is the same exact baseline0fc7de7 AI in both. No campaign grants, save edits, scripted splits or player Lead defense commands.
method.playerPolicyDifferenceFromEarlierExpedit: Balanced research priority is unchanged, but its remaining actions now use a fixed baseline player AI in both variants, rather than each variant AI. Thus only the three rival governments adopt the new assignment policy. This isolates AI adoption; it does not measure human use of defense control.
method.observer: Identical read-only command wrappers on rival/player AI record every successful assignment immediately, including cost and location. Identical game.js hooks bracket every actual fleet-versus-fleet duel, including battles outside player sensors; these observations are retrospective metrics and are never given to any policy. Neither current flag counts nor retained public battle reports are used as event counts.
method.equality: Every measured configuration has one complete uninstrumented replay from the same seed. Entire JSON states are compared after every round and at campaign completion, not merely selected fields. At cycles20/40/60, a JSON-reloaded raw checkpoint also runs the same next round and must match exactly. Raw validation repeats are not counted as extra outcome samples.
method.validity: Every initial and post-round state in both instrumented and raw executions must validate and have finite nonnegative credits/minerals/science/orders for all four factions. A winning AI action can finish a campaign before incrementing the turn; completedCycles counts only actual increments.
method.metrics: Assignments count successful false/absent-to-true lead commands; assignmentOrders sums exact before/after order differences and each must equal1. Redundant no-ops and failures are separate. Lead-defender duels count each actual battle call whose defender is marked at entry, even if the same formation fights again later; they do not count attacks made by a marked fleet or nonparticipants. Fleet-combat ship/hull losses sum immediate participant before/after differences for those duels only, excluding invasions, upkeep and other removal. AssignmentExamples/leadDuelExamples retain only the first5 per run; all counts include the complete run.
method.limitations: Eight fixed seeds with two scripted policies are a regression/balance probe, not human win-rate estimates. Ordering changes can alter subsequent combat RNG consumption, strategy and campaign duration. Loss totals are descriptive, not equal-exposure causal casualty estimates. No additional seeds or cohorts were run.

balanced.description: Existing mixed research priority, then pinned baseline AI for all other player commands at normal costs/orders. It never assigns defense leads.
